headline: Margin Pressure Persists

highlights: We arrive at a target price of Rs9,300 (earlier Rs11,678) implying an upside of 29.2% from the CMP of Rs7,200 and maintain our BUY rating on the stock. 2QFY27 performance update: Revenue (including other operating income) declined 0.4% YoY to Rs11.5bn in 2QFY27.
Gross margin stood at 58.9% versus 61.3% in 2QFY26 as COGS rose 5.6% YoY to 41.1% of sales.
EBITDA declined 8.7% YoY to Rs2.6bn, while EBITDA margin contracted to 22.7% in 2QFY27 from 24.8% in 2QFY26 and expanded from 19.1% in 1QFY27.
Reported PAT, equal to adjusted PAT, declined 6.7% YoY to Rs1.96bn.
valuation: We value the company at 36x (revised down from 40x) blended FY28E-29E EPS of (Rs252.9/Rs262.0), at a 46% discount to its 10-year average P/E of 66.5x, reflecting near-term earnings moderation and profitability headwinds.
